Capture Studio 0.1.1

  • The installer disk image now opens a proper window: drag Capture Studio onto Applications.
  • Development and release builds no longer show up as extra copies of the app in Spotlight and the Apps launcher.
  • This update arrives through the built-in updater, so you do not need to reinstall.

Capture Studio 0.1.0

The first release of Capture Studio, a menu bar screenshot app for macOS.

  • Capture an area, a window, or the full screen with global shortcuts.
  • A thumbnail appears after each capture: copy, save, annotate, pin, or drag it into any app.
  • Mark up captures with arrows, shapes, text, callouts, numbered steps, highlights, blur, pixelate, and solid redaction.
  • Find any capture again in History, including by the text inside it.
  • Pin a capture so it floats above other windows.
  • Copy the text from any part of the screen with Extract Text.
  • Updates arrive inside the app. To get test builds early, choose the Beta update channel in Settings > Updates.
